views.purpose: Identify top-level modules, subsystems, their specific responsibilities, containment hierarchy, and ownership of the seat booking functionality and reservation storage.
required_evidence: modules or subsystems that own the task, named by responsibility

views.purpose: Determine dependencies between modules to understand which components are directly dependent on the reservation storage module and might be affected by modifications to booking rules.
Map runtime components and connectors to analyze control-flow interactions between the booking request handler and seat availability checker, as well as connections to external notification services.
Bridge the architectural components and the implementing types to prepare for modifying the seat booking code.
required_evidence: architecture elements mapped to implementing types
